title: Sunny and the Little Bilby
author: Jamie Wigg
the_end_text:
The End.
Sweet dreams, little one. Goodnight.
back_cover_blurb: When the sky turns soft and blue, little Sunny the quokka meets a gentle bilby with the biggest, softest ears in the whole desert. Together they dig cosy burrows, listen to the quiet night, and watch the stars blink awake. A calm, cosy bedtime tale for winding down and drifting off to sleep. Perfect for little ones ages 1-5.

pages.scene: Sunny the little quokka sits in the soft blue evening on a patch of warm honey-gold sand, surrounded by low desert scrub and a few tall gum trees. The sky is deep plum-navy, the first stars just waking, and a gentle golden glow washes over her round fuzzy cheeks.
pages.text: The day had gone to sleep, and the sky turned soft and blue. Sunny the little quokka sat quietly, watching the evening settle in.

pages.scene: Sunny wanders slowly through the moonlit bush, honey-gold light on her fur, the desert scrub glowing warmly around her. A silver moon hangs low in the plum-navy sky, and tiny fireflies drift like sleepy sparks.
pages.text: A cool little breeze wandered by, so Sunny wandered too. The moon rose up, round and kind, lighting her gentle way.

pages.scene: Sunny pauses beside a small sandy mound, her ears perked, tilting her head. Soft golden light pools around a little scattering of sand near the roots of a gum tree. Fireflies hover, stars twinkle overhead.
pages.text: Then Sunny heard a soft little sound. Scritch, scritch, scratch — someone was digging in the warm sand.

pages.scene: A tiny bilby peeks out from a small burrow in the honey-gold sand — soft blue-grey fur, a long pointed snout, and enormous rabbit-like ears glowing in the moonlight. Sunny watches with a warm, curious smile. Deep plum-navy sky and gentle fireflies frame the scene.
pages.text: Out popped a little bilby, with the biggest, softest ears Sunny had ever seen. “Hello,” whispered the bilby. “Hello,” whispered Sunny.

pages.scene: Sunny and the little bilby sit close together on the warm sand under a gum tree, moonlight and firefly glow around them. The bilby's long ears turn gently. Both look softly at each other, cosy and calm in the plum-navy night.
pages.text: “I come out only at night,” said the bilby kindly. “When the sky is quiet and the sand is cool.”

pages.scene: The little bilby gently scoops soft honey-gold sand with tiny paws, beginning a cosy burrow beneath the desert scrub. Sunny watches, chin resting on her paws. Warm golden light, twinkling stars, drifting fireflies.
pages.text: “Let me show you where I sleep,” the bilby said softly. And with tiny paws, it began to dig a cosy burrow.

pages.scene: A small tunnel of warm sand curves down into a snug, rounded burrow, glowing softly gold from within. The bilby's long ears poke out. Sunny peeks in with a sleepy, gentle smile. Plum-navy night above, fireflies drifting.
pages.text: Down, down, curled the little tunnel, round and snug and warm. “It keeps me cool by day and cosy all night long.”

pages.scene: The bilby lifts its enormous soft ears high, listening to the quiet desert. Sunny copies, cupping her own little round ears. Moonlit scrub, honey-gold sand, deep plum-navy sky sprinkled with stars and gentle fireflies.
pages.text: “My big ears hear everything,” the bilby whispered. “The breeze, the sand, the smallest sleepy sound.”

pages.scene: Sunny and the bilby sit very still together, eyes soft and half-closed, listening. The desert is calm and hushed, bathed in warm gold and moon-silver light, fireflies floating slowly by beneath a starry plum-navy sky.
pages.text: So they sat and listened, quiet as could be. The night hummed gently, soft and slow, like a lullaby.

pages.scene: The little bilby gently noses through the sand, finding tiny seeds and a small beetle among the roots of the scrub. Sunny watches warmly. Honey-gold glow, moonlight, drifting fireflies, deep plum-navy sky.
pages.text: “At night I hunt for little seeds,” said the bilby, “and tiny bugs that hide beneath the sand.”

pages.scene: The bilby nibbles a small seed peacefully while Sunny nibbles a soft leaf beside it. The two sit together on warm sand under a leaning gum tree, cosy and content in the golden firefly light of the plum-navy night.
pages.text: The bilby nibbled a seed, and Sunny nibbled a leaf. Side by side, they shared a quiet little feast.

pages.scene: Sunny and the bilby tip their heads back to gaze up at a wide sky full of twinkling silver stars over the honey-gold desert. The moon glows softly, fireflies drift, and the scrub is bathed in warm calm light.
pages.text: Then together they looked up, up to the twinkling sky. “Look,” breathed Sunny, “the stars are coming out to say goodnight.”

pages.scene: A big round silver moon glows over the desert, casting soft honey-gold light on Sunny and the little bilby who sit close, watching. Countless stars shimmer in the deep plum-navy sky, and fireflies float like tiny lanterns.
pages.text: The moon shone bright and round, watching over them both. The whole quiet desert glowed, warm and safe and soft.

pages.scene: The little bilby yawns wide, its long ears drooping sleepily. Sunny yawns too, eyes gently half-closed. They lean close on the warm sand, moonlight and firefly glow wrapping around them in the calm plum-navy night.
pages.text: The bilby gave a great big yawn, its ears all soft and low. “It's nearly time for sleep,” it murmured, slow and low.

pages.scene: Sunny and the bilby nestle close together for a moment beside the cosy burrow, both looking drowsy and content. Soft gold light, twinkling stars, and drifting fireflies fill the peaceful plum-navy scene.
pages.text: Sunny yawned a sleepy yawn. “I'm feeling sleepy too.” The stars blinked kindly down, as if to say they knew.

pages.scene: The little bilby settles softly at the entrance of its warm glowing burrow, ears curled down cosily. Sunny stands nearby with a gentle, sleepy smile, waving a small paw. Moonlit sand, fireflies, deep plum-navy starry sky.
pages.text: “Goodnight, little bilby,” Sunny whispered soft and sweet. “Goodnight, dear Sunny,” said the bilby, snug and neat.

pages.scene: Sunny pads slowly home across the moonlit desert grass, honey-gold light on her fur, gum trees standing quietly in the plum-navy night. Fireflies drift along beside her and stars twinkle softly overhead.
pages.text: Through the soft moonlit grass, little Sunny padded home. The night held her gently, so she never felt alone.

pages.scene: Sunny reaches her cosy little nest tucked among the roots of a warm gum tree, lit with soft golden glow. She yawns and settles down into the snug leaves. Stars and fireflies shine gently through the plum-navy dark.
pages.text: Sunny reached her cosy nest, all warm and soft and deep. She curled up small and snug, and closed her eyes to sleep.

pages.scene: Sunny is curled up fast asleep in her cosy nest, a peaceful smile on her fuzzy face. Soft honey-gold light and gentle fireflies surround her, the moon watching over from the calm plum-navy sky above the sleeping desert.
pages.text: Her breathing slowed, so soft and slow, all cosy in the night. The moon kept watch above her, warm and calm and bright.

pages.scene: A dreamy, glowing image above the sleeping Sunny shows the little bilby with its big soft ears, drifting among stars and swirls of honey-gold and plum-navy dream-clouds, gentle fireflies twinkling all around.
pages.text: And in her sleepy dreams, a little bilby played, with big soft ears and starlight. Goodnight, sweet Sunny. Goodnight.
